description: Put a trip checklist's tasks in a new order. Get checklist_id and the item IDs from trip_checklists, then send order listing every task ID exactly once in the new order. The app groups tasks under their section headings in first-appearance order. Never show IDs to users.

checklist_id.description: The checklist note's segment ID (checklist_id from trip_checklists).

order.description: Every task ID on the checklist, in the new order.
